name: Tobias Larke

poster.hook: One fiance, left at the altar, then reported dead. The groom would like a word.

story.appearance: Tall and curly-haired, with a mouth built for smiling and a face that is bad at hiding things. His peacock-blue waistcoat is patched at one elbow, and he wears a lute case on his back like a second, better-behaved personality.
story.concept: Tobias is a jobbing minstrel who can charm a stone out of its mortgage. Two years ago he fell for Corvin Pell, who was charming, wealthy and always about to be wealthier. Corvin vanished on the morning of the wedding, taking Tobias's grandmother's lute 'to be restrung'. Six weeks ago the news arrived that Corvin had died, and Tobias sang at the funeral.
story.stake: His grandmother's lute, Old Marigold, is somewhere in this house, and his invitation says it is in Lot Thirteen. He has also never been able to decide whether he wants to hug Corvin or hit him.
story.goal: Get Old Marigold back, and finally ask Corvin's ghost, or his heirs, or anyone, why he ran.
story.secret: Corvin wrote to him before the funeral: 'I need to die for a while, darling. Please sing at it, and make sure the lid stays shut.' Tobias did exactly that, because he loved him and was promised the lute back. He has told no one, and he knows the tune Corvin whistles when he is happy.
story.voice: Warm, quick and generous with endearments for strangers. Slips into rhyme when upset. Never answers a hard question without a flourish.
mannerisms: Hums fragments of 'The Magpie's Waltz' without noticing
Retunes his lute whenever he is lying
Calls everybody 'darling', including people he is about to rob
story.trinket: A cracked wedding band on a leather cord, never worn

ties.text: He sang at the funeral and insisted on guarding the lid. Anselm watched him a little too long, and Tobias is sure Anselm suspects.
ties.public: Sang at the funeral; Anselm watched him throughout

ties.text: Nettle juggled in his old troupe, the Merry Perils. He has paid their bail twice and has never been thanked, only repaid in stolen cheese.
ties.public: Old troupe-mates; he paid their bail twice

ties.text: Corvin's apprentice. Tobias treats her like a kid sister and has no idea she made half the jewelry Corvin ever gave him.
ties.public: Corvin's apprentice; he thinks of her as a kid sister

story.intro: "Tobias Larke, darling, at your service and under protest. Do tell me you have not seen a lute. Brown, sad, answers to Marigold."

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

features.name: Skill Versatility
features.text: You gained proficiency in two skills of your choice (Persuasion and Insight).

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d6)
features.text: Bonus action: give an ally within 60 ft who can hear you a d6 to add to one roll within the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.text: Add half your proficiency bonus to ability checks you aren't already proficient in.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.text: During a short rest, allies who spend Hit Dice and hear your performance regain an extra d6 HP.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double proficiency on Performance and Persuasion.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.text: Reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract it from an enemy's attack roll, damage roll or ability check (within 60 ft, can hear you).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Lore bonus: three extra skills (Arcana, Sleight of Hand, Investigation).

features.name: By Popular Demand
features.text: You can always find a place to perform and get free lodging and food for yourself and companions in exchange.

attacks.name: Vicious Mockery
attacks.note: Target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of your next turn

attacks.name: Dissonant Whispers
attacks.note: 1st-level slot; half on a save. On a fail the target uses its reaction to flee

spellcasting.note: Knows 6 spells and 2 cantrips; can swap one known spell when gaining a level.

equipment.name: Lute
equipment.note: A cheap replacement. Old Marigold is somewhere in Pell House

equipment.name: Admirer's Love Letter
equipment.note: Favor of an admirer; written by Corvin, naturally

attack.name: Vicious Mockery
attack.note: Target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of your next turn

value.name: Friends
value.note: Concentration; advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature, who realizes afterward

choices.label: Wedding band
choices.value: A cracked wedding band on a leather cord, never worn

choices.label: Pawn ticket
choices.value: A pawn ticket for a lute he no longer owns

choices.label: Corvin's last letter
choices.value: Corvin's last letter, folded small and worn soft

flashback: What were the last words Corvin said to you on the morning of the wedding that never happened?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Run Tobias as the mournful minstrel in the ballroom band, loyal to Corvin's memory. He plays the first act, and Biscuit seems to know him. If the party needs the Waltz, someone else must carry the tune.

reassign.beat: The Magpie's Waltz, which calms Biscuit
reassign.text: You know the tune Corvin whistles when he is happy: five years of hearing it through a workshop wall, or three of hearing it round a troupe's fire. A few bars will calm the mimic.

reassign.beat: Corvin's note before the funeral: 'I need to die for a while'
reassign.text: A note reached you before the funeral in Corvin's own hand: 'I need to die for a while. Please make sure the lid stays shut.' You thought it a cruel joke. You are no longer sure.

cuts: The Tobias and Corvin heartbreak scene in the boathouse; Corvin addresses the room instead.
Old Marigold's recovery thread; the lute simply sits in Biscuit's gut as treasure.
The Merry Perils bail-and-cheese gags with Nettle.

keepsake.name: The ring he kept
keepsake.note: Bought for an altar, carried to an auction, and still in his pocket.
